## Schedule Result

The PM-requested 2026-09-04 go/no-go date and 2026-09-07 launch date can be carried as conditional targets, but the current evidence does not support them as committed dates or a schedule baseline.

The requested launch date conflicts with the current plan because production preparation is scheduled for 2026-09-07 through 2026-09-09. If 2026-09-07 is retained, production preparation, content readiness, backup and restore, HTTPS, monitoring, support readiness, and final approval must be complete before the release. No evidence currently provides dates, owners, durations, or float for that work.

## Delivery Sequence

1. Complete and date the Gate 1 environment and ownership evidence.
2. Resolve the conflict between the Gate 2 participant-creation condition and `D-16 (Prioritize session lifecycle administration and defer participant account lifecycle work)`.
3. Provision and verify staging before treating the local vertical slice as a schedule milestone.
4. Complete remaining launch-scope build, content, security, responsive, participant, and operational evidence.
5. Complete the go/no-go review on 2026-09-04 if all entry conditions pass.
6. Complete production preparation and LeadLab Director approval before the proposed 2026-09-07 release.
7. Keep SharePoint ready as the fallback if any launch gate fails.

## Forecast Recommendation

Keep 2026-09-04 and 2026-09-07 as PM-requested conditional targets. Do not baseline them until the Gate 1 date, accountable owners, staging path, participant-access direction, production-preparation sequence, and final-approval timing are confirmed. If those inputs are not available, retain the SharePoint fallback and do not claim the custom-app launch date is credible.
